CustomField.description: Where the comparison value comes from. Literal uses Value as typed, converted to the field's type and passed as a bind variable. Relative Date uses a Salesforce date literal from a closed whitelist, e.g. LAST_N_DAYS:30, which is how you make a count drain over time instead of growing forever. Routed Record Field reads Value off the record being routed, which lets a cap depend on the incoming record; it supports the equals operator only.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Literal, a date literal like LAST_N_DAYS:30, or a field off the record being routed.
CustomField.label: Value Source
